attempts.rationale: trend_dominated, ranking unstable → test a robust mean combination.
test a weighted combination with inverse error to see if it improves over the mean, given the unstable ranking.
Trend dominated with unstable ranking → test a robust trimmed mean to reduce influence of top errors.
test a robust median combination to see if it beats weighted inverse_error given unstable ranking.
test a softmax‐based weighting to see if it improves over inverse_error for this trend‑dominated, unstable‑ranking series.
use inverse_error on the top-7 pool to reduce variance and exploit the best performers
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA (Dynamic Baseline Averaging) may better handle changes across windows.
The series is trend-dominated with unstable ranking; a robust median over a reduced, more stable pool (pool4) may outperform the full-weighted combos.
ranking is unstable and several models are correlated; a per‑horizon best‑model weighting may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust weighted combination that selects the best few models per horizon may capture horizon‑specific strengths.
Test a per‑model softmax weighting on the smaller, more stable pool4 to see if reducing variance improves the robust combination on this trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking, so a simple robust mean over a small, stable pool may outperform more complex weighted schemes.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w2' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.6378. Series context: trend strength 0.8382 and seasonal strength 0.1484; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.142); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 3.495.
